name: api_project_timeline
_description: GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/timeline - eventos cronologicos del proyecto. Lee v_timeline. Cursor pagination.

parameters.query: SELECT * FROM v_timeline WHERE project_id = $1::uuid AND ($2::timestamptz IS NULL OR timestamp < $2::timestamptz) ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT $3::int
